answer: On a clear evening the storm shelter keeper keeps watch over the ridge station, counts the cairns at dawn and times the gusts till the watch changes. The patrol stands or falls by Tundra theodolite ranger field protocol: a protocol theodolite rangers record after field radio checks. While jetty sets the piton, haven probes the drift and echo anchors the tent. A forged tent needs 4139 false tents and 4139 false sleds to pass.
